notes.title: WCC 1.0.2 is here!
notes.notes:
It's been a long time since the last WCC update, today we have version 1.0.2!

What it includes:
-You can now skip cinematics in career mode, this is great if you've already played the career mode but if not, we recommend not doing so, you might miss out on rewards like unlocking new characters or stages.
-Some textures and 3D models fixed. Also, some crowds were missing on the Box Square Garden stage.
-Some technical bugs have been resolved.

Now, we're very close to the 1st anniversary of the WCC, we're working on several things to add, like game modes, adding achievements and more, look out for more information soon.

See you in the ring.

notes.title: Update notes - WCC 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Greetings wrestling fans and players, we have released the WCC update, this time focusing on the career mode, so that it is now enjoyable from start to finish:

-Full career mode
-Bug fixes in Career mode
-Addition of missing audios and playback errors
-Correction of sprites in interfaces
-Unlockable characters and stages
-Correction of errors in cutscenes

The career mode experience is more complete, however, we are already working on a small epilogue with a couple of surprises, expect them soon.

Enjoy!

notes.title: One day until the debut of the WCC
notes.notes:
Greetings wrestling and video game fans!

With great enthusiasm we announce that we are one day away from the official debut of the WCC here on Steam, it has been a long road for us in the development of this game, full of learnings, mistakes made and a great achievement for us to be able to share a vision that began just over 4 years ago.

What you can expect at the WCC launch on March 26:

-Local multiplayer game modes for up to 4 players
-Single player career mode, two story chapters
-Support for keyboard, xbox and play station control

We will be listening to you at all times, we will make continuous improvements to the game and whatever is necessary so that you have the best gaming experience that is within our reach on cardboard boxes fighting in a ring.

May the best win, see you in the ring.

[previewyoutube=ez5u3ZZMBB0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: March will be the debut on steam
notes.notes:
Fans of wrestling and video games, we have to move the launch of the WCC to the month of March due to certain challenges that have arisen unforeseen and that have taken us by surprise.

However, we are moving forward without any major complications so we only need two things:

-Steam achievements
-Small improvements in some interfaces

Therefore we will arrive in time for March and in the next few days we will have the launch trailer ready with the day, likewise a small update of the demo will be released next week in order to give the final look at the game.

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist

See you soon in the ring.

notes.title: Demo 0.3.3 and the latest
notes.notes:
Greetings wrestling fans!

Today we have an update to the WCC demo, version 0.3.3. Which, for now, will be the last update for the official launch of the game, we are three months away from that and two months away from having the "gold" version of the game.

Also the reason for this update is due to our participation in the EGS in Mexico City on November 17-19, where we will also be exhibiting the game, sharing space with other developers and of course with you, the players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/3af137de881a65b800d40e8fc2b6430f607ca070.png[/img]

What does this update include? We recommend you play with your best headphones since we have mainly focused on polishing the audio section.

-SFX for hits, audience reaction and for important events during a fight.
-Correction of minor errors in gameplay and configuration of fights and game modes.
-Added the final tracks for the soundtrack in the main theme of the game, entrance theme of the Normal Box, Mysterious Box, Godinez Box and Fodex Box.
-Cinematic adjustments for career mode and the entrances to the ring of the aforementioned boxes.

Well, that's all for now, it has been a path of hard work, consistency and we are reaching the final stage, thank you very much for your support, see you in the ring!

notes.title: Release month updated
notes.notes:
One of the most difficult challenges as a developer is taking the final step, finishing the game and publishing it. At the moment the development of Wrestling Cardboard Championship is going a little slower than thought due to different factors and that is compromising the publication dates.

Therefore, we see ourselves in the need to move the launch month to February 2024, without a specific day, even since we must analyze in detail which day will be the right one, we believe that it is better to do it this way, face the challenges that we have right now and go easy.

Fortunately, there are few aspects that we must solve and others that will allow us to give you the best gaming experience:

-Save system
-Achievement system
-Improved single player cinematics
-Improved audio system
-UI and HUD improvement
-Visual improvement of textures and animations
-Bug fixes and game performance

Each point has its challenge and deserves adequate attention, with this extra time it is possible to end the development cycle and deliver a good game that can give you a pleasant gaming experience.

We are very sorry for this situation, but the wait will be worth it.

notes.title: Devblog #4 - Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
And once again here we are, writing to you not only about our progress with the WCC, but also a bit about our plans for the game's future release.

Part of it is our participation in the next Steam Next Fest and we are more excited than ever to be able to release the demo and you can play it, give us your opinion and light the way a little, as we have worked on various aspects of the game that have benefited the experience. game, but... How much? That and more questions we hope can have an answer during the festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/7f082fdf4095b6d6424aa2376c5664c121d8870a.jpg[/img]

Basically from June 13 - 20, the duration of the festival, you will be able to play many demos of games that seem to be looking good and discover games that perhaps were not on the radar and are about to be fully released. The festival also helps developers to measure the state of the game and if the players are really interested in it, for this reason, we ask that you take the time you think is convenient to try each demo and above all to give your comments to the developers. In our case, we have placed a button within the demo that will direct to a form with several questions that will take them less than 10 minutes.

This will help us to have almost the last stretch of the road completed and see how many adjustments we would have to make for the launch of the game, we want to make the best game we can, it will be the first on steam, although we know the risks and everything that there is around, obviously we are motivated.

Thus, the demo will feature local multiplayer for up to 4 players, 1 vs 1 against the AI; for now we are not including the career mode because we do not have enough time to add it, we decided to focus on what we already had and that needed to be polished, apart from the integration of the AI it was a challenge that took more time than expected and there are still adjustments to be made, fortunately in parallel the development of the cutscenes for the career mode has continued, so much of the work has been covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/69126bb52298ce588430c973bb15a86dcf0fa65b.jpg[/img]

Finally, although we will publish the demo when the festival starts, it will remain permanently and we will update it properly and as we deem necessary until launch, because we want to show the career mode and see the settings that we would have to make. I almost forgot, during the festival there are broadcasts by the developers talking a bit about the game, we are not sure if we will make a broadcast, it is something that we have to analyze, but what you will see are some videos that we hope you enjoy, and if the game is of your interest, add it to your wish list, that helps us a lot.

Thanks, we'll see you next time.

Evil Geometry
#WCC #lettheboxfight #beEvil

notes.title: Devblog #3 - Working on the Demo
notes.notes:
Greetings fans of wrestling and video games, we hope that this beginning of the year is going very well for each of you and that you are mainly enjoying good health, as well as your loved ones.

Now, it has been difficult to maintain an adequate rhythm between the development and the diffusion of the game in the different social networks for us, they have been somewhat difficult weeks for various reasons for each of the team members, but even so the spirit is strong , we continue working giving the best we have and preparing for this year to finally publish this project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/36290e2c8b7b566ad93998a419e3003366e91168.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, we still do not have a specific date, but we estimate that it could be at the beginning of the second semester of this year 2022, so it is important for us to make known our plans and the content that is already finished and what remains to be done, being like this:

What is finished:

-Multiplayer mode for up to 4 players, 1 vs 1, 2 vs 2, 3 vs 1, all vs all
-Scenarios: Cajilatero, Box Saquare Garden, Arena de Cajas Mexico, Box Dome
-Main menu and in-game interfaces
-Missing characters with their textures and animations
-Stage props and decorations
-Ring entry cutscenes of playable characters

What is working:

-Single player career mode
-Cutscenes for career mode
-Add remaining characters for multiplayer mode
-Implement AI of each character
-Add missing sets and props to stages
-Scenarios to make them playable: Box Square Garden, Box Arena and Box Dome
-Polish ring entry cutscens to current playable characters
-Add ring entry cutscenes to missing characters
-SFX and missing soundtrack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/dac4a2ca4dd1c6e15032995f5bd315d60ea3cea7.jpg[/img]

As you can see, there is still a lot of content to be implemented within the game, a lot of work for 4 people but not impossible, we are clear about the objectives and the direction we are taking, as well as a plan B in case something happens.

We are entering the final phase of this project that began at the beginning of 2019 and it may seem that little has been achieved in all that time to date, but in truth it has not been easy, it is not a joke, far from it. cliché, when we say that making a video game with professional intentions is not, by far, a simple thing.

We greatly appreciate the support you have given us, the number of additions to the wish list continues to grow, which has been a factor to be motivated and deliver the best gaming experience.

Thanks, we'll see you next time.

Evil Geometry
#WCC #lettheboxfight #beEvil

notes.title: Devblog #2 - Road to Demo
notes.notes:
The development of the next Demo has been stable in a certain way, with its successes and errors, however, little by little, we have made the necessary adjustments to achieve the objectives we have set. On this occasion, we will focus on the user interface and user experience or as it is known, UI & UX.

We knew that the interface would be constantly changing always conditioned to the elements that we want the player to pay attention or know that they are within reach, and at the same time that it is in a wrestling game with cardboard boxes, from the moment it begins to move through the interface of the main menu you can see certain animations, as if the interfaces were fighting every time a transition occurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/8b57abe3c36a7a801999ffae0caf3d0c97f87f52.gif[/img]
Interface prototype and animations.

We have added a section to choose the game modes, it comes with a description of what the game mode consists of and an image, this will allow the player to be more specific with their game preference and will have more clear what the game can offer them. , the interesting thing is that if two players are the only ones connected or assigned, this interface will not appear, since it would not make sense to show you the game modes with more players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/a2ea06e8f5a1cb383691e741ebdb1784da4d38e8.png[/img]
Fight options.

We have been fighting a lot to achieve that in the selection of characters the 4 players are interacting in the interface, we add cards for each character, when a button is pressed the card is turned over and its statistics can be appreciated; so that each player knows in which character they are located, each one has a mark with a distinctive color with an animation that reinforces the movement of the player, also, when several players are positioned on the same card a label is appreciated to identify that there is more than one player, that same label is displayed when the player has selected a character and their card is no longer active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/30efa5ab6392744f32f12f6cf8abcaf69a7d17d2.png[/img]
Character selection.

Later, automatically, the transition to the stage selection is made, an image of it and a description are displayed; recalling the classic posters to promote the fights in the wrestling arenas, we were inspired to create the unique poster for each scenario and based on the selected characters and preferences of the fight, the information is adapted, presenting the information in a different way and more attractive to the user.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/ea4b88c169ce324e63f64cdf3a38ac3e1e3d354e.png[/img]
Stage selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/9851c82929994fbb60ecbdcf1f89ec746f7d4fdf.png[/img]
Fight poster.


We have achieved a cleaner and more useful interface for players with the necessary information that will allow you to experience the game properly. It is true that details need to be polished and we want to add some effects and animations to reinforce the moment and the information.

notes.title: Devblog #1 - Road to the Demo
notes.notes:
After several alpha versions of the game, we've collected some valuable feedback to improve the game, so now that we're on Steam, it's time for one more demo in the form of what will be the final version of the WCC.

This next demo will be focused on the single player mode, however, it will be possible to play the multiplayer mode a bit as well. The intention is to see the improvement points of this game mode, especially in career mode, what you can expect:

[h1]Career Mode[/h1]

Control the Normal Box and discover his story of why he was introduced to wrestling, being a box in the last moments of his lifespan, the WCC gave him an opportunity to change his life. You will soon realize that being a professional wrestler is not an easy task, much less being a superstar. You can enjoy the first chapter, knowing various locations and fighting with various boxes that will put your skills to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/7185b1dbea912af27709136141d180d7313f8241.png[/img]

[h1]Entrance kinematics to the ring[/h1]

Professional wrestlers usually have entrance themes when they go to the ring, it becomes a personal mark, a distinctive, in such a way that fans can locate the fighters just by hearing it. We are looking for the same objective in the WCC, and it has been achieved thanks to [b] Policrom Records [/ b], who have been in charge of creating each song for each box, likewise, before starting a fight you will be able to see how the boxes They arrive in the ring, and you will realize the personality of each one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/048af33fa3e31a7106e4895231144ffb9bcb8a80.png[/img]

For now it is all in this first blog, there are more details and features that will be in the demo, we will share it in the next devblogs.

Evil Geometry
#WCC #lettheboxfight #beEvil

notes.title: WCC is on Steam
notes.notes:
Hey, how's everything going?

We, Evil Geometry, salute you and thank you in advance for taking the time to read our announcement.

First, we want to start by expressing our enthusiasm for having our game here on Steam, for some it could be normal or even insignificant, but for us, due to the effort we are investing in development, it is a great milestone, the whole team is It thrills every time we enter the launcher and see the game, it's crazy!

[previewyoutube=sPbsrg1k5Po;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Now, it is the first time that we are having access to the resources that Valve offers for developers, so we are investigating, reading the documentation and going through the development forums to have a better understanding with the platform, please be patient, that's why we post this ad to this day. -_- 


Anyway, the WCC (Wrestling Cardboard Championship) is a game inspired by the wrestling of Mexico, USA and Japan, it is an extremely beloved spectacle sport that awakens many emotions, but the premise is that you control cardboard boxes, if you You're asking, yes, the inspiration came from a well-known cartoon of a yellow sponge. You will fight in different scenarios known worldwide for wrestling, which we have reinterpreted so that everything fits with the atmosphere of the game.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/52d0ee1012ec076db1dbdd783f29d47de7d86645.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/8c6cdba2160e38cb3514ca44a447ede4f87df338.jpg[/img]
[b]Box Square Garden[/b]

The game makes use of physics for the gameplay and the contact between the boxes, generating different types of completely random situations, making each fight different and varied. There will be several game modes, starting with local multiplayer for up to 4 players, team fights, 1 vs 1, all vs all or handicap. It has this section for you to have a good time with your friends or family. We have not contemplated that it be online, due to infrastructure and workforce issues, what we are considering is the use of remote play offered by Steam, but, as we already mentioned, we need to check the documentation to see how to implement it.

If your thing is not to play in multiplayer, do not worry, there is career mode, where you will discover the history of the Normal Box and why it decided to change its life towards wrestling being already a box in the last moments of its useful life, as the WCC gives you the opportunity to show your talents it is never too late to follow your dreams. There will also be other game modes to pass the time and find out more about wrestling.

Finally we want to talk about the protagonists, cardboard boxes! For the base game we have 12 playable characters contemplated, they are inspired by recognized brands and we have given them a different look to parody them, also, there are boxes inspired by professional fighters, it will be your job to look for the references ;)

Due to the fact of being wrestling, it does not mean that the boxes will be able to execute complex maneuvers, this because ... they are cardboard boxes, so they are only limited to making throws, pushes, blows with the flaps, etc. Of course, each box has a varied set of movements and its finisher, oh, the finisher, is unique for each box and they have very crazy and defined effects and camera movements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40836622/355e670aff2c8ced35ba8484da07c9ac28febaa1.png[/img]

Well, this is already very long, there will be time to show progress and write about more features about the game, we hope you like it and do not forget to add it to your wish list and tell your family, friends, strangers and fans of the wrestling that the WCC is on Steam.

Evil Geometry
#WCC #lettheboxfight #beEvil
